<issue>
GIF image handling returns wrong content type and dimensions

#### Description

When working with GIF images, the library incorrectly reports the content type as PNG instead of GIF, and the dimensions are swapped (width/height reversed).

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.image.gif import Gif
from docx import MIME_TYPE
import io

# Test content type
gif = Gif(None, None, None, None)
print(f"Expected: {MIME_TYPE.GIF}")
print(f"Actual: {gif.content_type}")

# Test dimensions parsing
cx, cy = (42, 24)  # expected width=42, height=24
bytes_ = b'filler*\x00\x18\x00'  # sample GIF header bytes
stream = io.BytesIO(bytes_)
gif = Gif.from_stream(stream)
print(f"Expected dimensions: width={cx}, height={cy}")
print(f"Actual dimensions: width={gif.px_width}, height={gif.px_height}")
```

The content type should be `image/gif` but returns `image/png`. Additionally, when parsing GIF dimensions from the stream, width and height values get swapped.
</issue>
